scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @devpraxis/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @devpraxis/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @devpraxis/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
